method.referenceChecks: Modern Robotics code library, docstring worked examples of MatrixExp3, MatrixLog3, MatrixExp6, MatrixLog6, TransInv, Adjoint, FKinBody, FKinSpace, JacobianBody, JacobianSpace, IKinBody and IKinSpace; Universal Robots' UR5 DH table
method.forwardKinematics: URDF joint chain from the file; standard DH (Rz(theta) Tz(d) Tx(a) Rx(alpha)); product of exponentials T = e^[S1]theta1 ... e^[S6]theta6 M
method.inverseKinematics: Newton-Raphson: theta <- theta + pinv(Js(theta)) Vs, with pinv = (J^T J)^-1 J^T; at most 20 steps; tolerances 0.001 rad and 0.1 mm
